description_short: Blueprint authoring, testing, and transport visualization tools for Captain of Industry designers.
description_long: Blueprint Designer's Toolkit (BDT) Blueprint authoring and testing tools for Captain of Industry designers. - Update blueprint: replace an existing blueprint from a new area selection while preserving name, description, overlap settings, and book position. - Recycle Bin: copy deleted or updated blueprints/folders into a configurable recycle bin folder to prevent accidental permanent loss. - Undo: undo recent blueprint placements and restore cuts with Ctrl+Z. - Remembered folder: reopen the blueprint book where you left it. - Operational stats: show workers, electricity, computing, and maintenance in the blueprint detail panel. - Copy as Markdown: copy single-blueprint summaries or recursive folder tables to the clipboard for Hub posts and documentation. - Symmetric normalization: normalize functionally identical balancer/connector orientations in captured blueprints to improve paste-over behavior. - Cut buildings: cut and paste completed buildings and player-laid pavement after Cut research, or immediately in Sandbox. Unique buildings are demolished before their replacements are placed. - Build behaviors and cleanup: Sandbox instant construction, deconstruction, paving and clearing, automatic belt and pipe tier matching, curvy incline belts, optional pipe pre-coloring, and a demolition preview for disconnected transport cleanup. - Height and layout visualization: zoom past the normal camera limits, filter layered logistics by height, control support-pillar visibility, and render layout boxes for clearance planning. - Throughput tools: monitor flow, show throughput overlays/heat maps, configure averaging periods, bulk-configure areas, and sandbox-test custom capacity limits. - Transport product removal: clear buffered products from transports and logistics entities individually or across a selected area, using regular truck collection or quick removal. - Environmental overlays: inspect pollution and radiation sources with local labels, heat maps, and optional entity highlighting. Designer-only, consumer-free: blueprints remain vanilla-compatible and players using your blueprints do not need this mod installed.
